rules.text: Some items are final sale and cannot be returned.
A $7.99 fee is deducted from the refund for return shipping when using the prepaid shipping label for mail returns.
rules.quote: $7.99 will be deducted from your refund to cover return shipping for standard size/weight packages when your return is mailed using the prepaid shipping label provided.

rules.text: Purchases of $500 or more made with cash will be refunded by check in store.
rules.quote: Purchases of $500 or more made with cash will be refunded by check.

rules.text: Store purchases returned by mail will be refunded by check.
rules.quote: Store purchases returned by mail will be refunded by check, including any portion purchased with Total REI Rewards.

rules.text: Gift return refunds by check can take up to 3 weeks starting from the day the return is received.
rules.quote: Refunds by check can take up to 3 weeks, starting the day we receive your return.

rules.text: Direct exchanges by mail are not offered.
rules.quote: Unfortunately, we are not able to offer direct exchanges by mail.
